in_sanskrit.name: Sansuma
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sansuma एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.

in_hindi.name: Sansuma
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Prosperity
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sansuma एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.

in_tamil.name: Sansuma
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess of Prosperity
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sansuma ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.

in_telugu.name: Sansuma
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess of Prosperity
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sansuma ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Sansuma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sansuma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Sansuma
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sansuma একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess of wealth, fortune, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘San’ meaning wealth, and ‘Suma’ meaning prosperity.
